steps.title: Open photon data
steps.text: Open or drop a TTTR scanner image, or resolve it from an authenticated MMFDB dataset.

steps.title: Configure calibration
steps.text: Import detector setup or expand Detector calibration to set channels, microtime windows and per-detector reference IRF. Set frequency and Min photons.

steps.title: Run and inspect
steps.text: Run computes every detector. Choose intensity, g/s, selected pixels or a photon/phasor movie from View.

steps.title: Select lifetime populations
steps.text: Open Phasor plot. Add ellipse or polygon gates in Gate regions, then drag their handles over a cluster. Selected pixels shows its corresponding image.

steps.title: Persist or explore
steps.text: Save cursor JSON and imaging HDF5/PTO results. ndX explores the live pixel table and Next advances an attached pipeline.
